content.title: Trump Equity Stakes: Critical Metals Soars, But Lithium Americas Stock Is A Sell
content.summary: Rare-earths mining play Critical Metals went vertical on amid news that the Trump administration was considering an equity stake in the company, though Bloomberg just threw cold water on the report.  Meanwhile, Lithium Americas, which tripled after the first report of a possible U.S. stake, received an underperform rating on Monday and a price target 45% below Friday's close.  Lithium Americas stock rose early but faded.

content.title: AMD soars on OpenAI deal, Tesla launch & Govt eyes Critical Metals
content.description:
Shares of AMD (AMD) are skyrocketing after announcing a major partnership with OpenAI (OPAI.PVT). As part of the agreement, OpenAI could take a 10% stake in the chipmaker. Other top trending stocks include Tesla (TSLA) as it teased a possible product launch in a pair of posts on X and Critical Metals shares are jumping on a report the U.S. government could take a stake in the rare earth company.

For more live coverage of markets watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and head to Yahoo Finance.
